integrity: Analytic characteristic-root counting supplies the proof. Included finite checks independently recompute crossing identities and sampled root locations; they do not certify the infinitely many delay roots. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact local orbital linear stability and unstable dimension only; no global attractor or secondary periodic-branch stability classification. Nonlinear critical-point behavior at the crossing values is not asserted. Original Hara 1997 full text was inaccessible and historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact Floquet instability staircase of the circular wave in a planar delay system
